bias.label: Leaning down below 3,651; range 3,575-3,700, bigger trend down

event: Today 17:00 SAST: US consumer confidence. Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US October PCE inflation and Q3 GDP. Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Bounce fading
bullets.text: Reuters (via ANC) had spot gold down 0.3% at 3,619.95 at 08:35 SAST, and a live quote near 3,622 at 09:40 SAST (UNVERIFIED single source).

bullets.title: Rejected at 3,651
bullets.text: Gold rose to about 3,645-3,651 in early Asia but was pushed back, after Monday's rally stalled under 3,700.

bullets.title: Hike still expected
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 93.5-96% odds of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December, with 50 bp bets small.

bullets.title: Strong dollar
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 104.3, close to a 19-month high, and the 10-year yield is near 4.92-4.95%.

bullets.title: Margin selling eased
bullets.text: Monday's stock rebound after Nvidia brought back its CEO cut forced gold selling, but that support is fading today.

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold is far below its 50-day average near 4,064 with RSI near 33, so rallies are bounces inside a downtrend.

bullets.title: PCE on Wednesday
bullets.text: PCE and GDP at 15:30 SAST Wednesday can swing gold fast, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
